title: Chapter 62 The Lord Of The City Is Invincible
content:
Chapter 62 The Lord Of The City Is Invincible

"Your Excellency, I wonder what happened to me in the deserted city?"

At this time, Huang Shou stepped forward and clasped his fists.

At this time, Huang Shou felt a little shocked, because the other party's aura was exactly the same as the one of his own city lord.

This is a strong man of the same level as their city lord!

If such a strong man becomes hostile to them, it will definitely be a devastating blow.

In the void, the mysterious man ignored Huang Shou and looked at the deepest part of Huang City.

"I've arrived in person. Haven't you come out to see me yet?"

Seeing that he was ignored, Huang Shou frowned slightly, but he did not dare to show any dissatisfaction, and then retreated.

He is not a fool.

If you don’t have the strength but still want to provoke such a strong man, isn’t it just a lantern in the toilet and looking for shit?

In the city lord's mansion.

Lu Daosheng looked at this scene and showed a sneer.

Unexpectedly, this guy is actually a human race.

It's really ironic.

The human race has a strong man from the realm of destiny, but the human race in the realm of the world has lived such a tragic life.

For a time, Lu Daosheng's favorability towards this human powerhouse plummeted.

"My desolate city is here. Whether to enter or not, please do it."

Lu Daosheng spoke casually.

Suddenly, the mysterious man in the void was stunned.

He didn't expect that the other party would be so arrogant.

Haha, interesting.

The man's mouth curled up an astonishing arc, then he took a step forward, directly ignoring all defense measures in the wasteland city, and directly entering the wasteland city.

This scene immediately made everyone in the deserted city widen their eyes.

This is the first time they have seen someone flying directly into the deserted city.

Is this the top powerhouse in the world?

In the city lord's mansion, Gu Chen and others also saw this scene and frowned.

"Master Lord, this guy is a little too arrogant, right?"

An Xing nodded too.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng just smiled faintly and said nothing.

He has not upgraded the ban in the city yet, so the other party can easily enter.

And in his eyes, the other party was like an ant.

To be precise, his eyes now are all ants.

Seeing Lu Daosheng's reaction, Gu Chen and others felt very uncomfortable.

Unexpectedly, even the city lord had no choice but to deal with the other party.

Yes, it is impossible for my own city lord to be invincible all the time.

And now, the city lord has reached its limit.

It seems that in the future, if you want to maintain the deserted city, you cannot always rely on the city lord, and you must work hard.

For a time, the mentality of several people not only did not decline, but became more and more determined.

Lu Daosheng noticed this and was slightly stunned.

What's the situation?

And at this moment, a figure appeared in the hall.

It was the mysterious man in the realm of destiny.

At this moment, another hazy aura around the mysterious man covered the man's face.

Gu Chen and others could not see through it.

But in Lu Daosheng's eyes, there is no difference between the other party and a naked man.

"Are you the Lord of the Wilderness City?"

At this time, the mysterious man spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, "It's me."

However, at this moment, the mysterious man frowned.

Because he suddenly realized something was wrong.

Why can't Lu Daosheng see through at the moment?

Just as he wanted to observe carefully, a bright red blood suddenly flowed out of the corners of his eyes.

"you!!"

"What did you do!?"

The mysterious man took a few steps back and stared at Lu Daosheng with fear.

Looking at this scene, Gu Chen and others took a few steps back unconsciously.

Could it be that the city lord is already taking action in secret at this moment.

Lu Daosheng was a little helpless about all this.

He did nothing, just because he was too strong at this moment, and an ant from the Heavenly Realm dared to stare at him like this. It would be strange if he didn't suffer backfire.

"Don't be nervous, you're just too weak."

At this time, Lu Daosheng said slowly.

Hearing this, the mysterious man suddenly laughed.

"I'm weak? Hahahaha."

A loud laugh suddenly sounded from the mysterious man's mouth, and then he sneered, "Do you know who I am?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said indifferently, "I don't know, I don't want to know."

At this moment, he was a little disappointed with the powerful man in the human race's Heavenly Destiny Realm.

He didn't expect that the other party was such a proud person.

Lu Daosheng was indeed a little confused about some things, so he wanted to ask this powerful man from the human race.

But now, it is no longer necessary.

"Do you think you're strong?"

At this time, the mysterious man looked at Lu Daosheng and sneered.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng stood up directly.

At the same time, Gu Chen and his friends looked at each other and knew that the city lord was going to take action.

Immediately, several people hurriedly retreated.

Soon, all the restrictions in the entire deserted city were activated in an instant.

For a moment, many powerful spiritual senses looked at the Huangcheng.

At this moment, the deserted city has become the focus of the world of all spirits.

"Let's take action."

Looking at Lu Daosheng, the mysterious man said lightly.

He wanted to let this guy who suddenly appeared to take a closer look at what a real powerhouse in the destiny realm is.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng did not refuse.

"As you wish."

Lu Daosheng put his index fingertip on his thumb and then bounced his finger.

boom!

With a deafening roar, it sounded.

An indescribable terrifying force was heading towards the mysterious man.

And the entire wasteland city, including the entire world of all spirits, was shocked at this moment.

Watching the terrifying force come towards me.

The mysterious man's pupils suddenly shrank.

A dazzling light appeared on the mysterious man's chest.

"Shocking power!"

Rumble!

Another explosion sounded.

Look outside the deserted city.

I saw a force soaring into the sky in the deepest part of the deserted city.

An irreparable cave entrance suddenly appeared in the sky of the entire world of all spirits.

The next moment, a figure was blown out from the deserted city.

The entire void was shattered at this moment.

In the sky, countless pieces floated down.

The air was filled with a breath of destruction.

The entire world of all spirits became quiet at this moment.

All living creatures, without exception, were staring blankly at the direction of the deserted city.

Snap instantly.

That mysterious human powerhouse in the Tianming Realm was instantly killed by the Lord of the Huangcheng City.

In the deserted city, after being shocked, everyone finally reacted and cheered immediately.

"The city lord is invincible!"

"The city lord is invincible!"

For a moment, the name of the Lord of the Huangcheng City resounded throughout the world of all spirits.

Somewhere in the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm, in a mountain range, at this moment, a huge sinkhole suddenly appeared here.

In the pit, the mysterious man was lying in the center without expectation.

He was not dead, but he understood that the other party deliberately showed mercy.

Why is he so powerful?

Isn’t he the realm of destiny?

All kinds of doubts appeared in the mysterious man's mind.

Immediately, he stood up again.

He stood up!

His expression suddenly became firm and then he looked towards the direction of the deserted city.

Even though he was bleeding all over his body at this moment, he still headed towards the direction of the deserted city without hesitation.

In the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

"City, Lord City."

Gu Chen and his friends came to the hall with anxiety.

At this moment, the hall was still filled with the destructive aura just now, which made Gu Chen Anxing and others tremble all over.

I sat up in a panic during the dying illness, but the clown was actually them.

Restoring the city lord’s limit, now it seems that the city lord has no limit.

The city lord is really invincible.
